title: Offers to donate papers to the University of Wyoming and the Smithsonian
summary: Leeman says the University of Wyoming asked for his memorabilia and that he would like important items to go to the Smithsonian.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: Milt, the University of Wyoming wrote me in great length and asked me if they could have any of my papers, drums, pictures or memorabilia -- I can't pronounce that one -- for their archives, and their music department and if I would leave some of them on my demise, and so I wrote them and told them they could have a lot of things, and it was up to my family to send them whatever may be important for their archives.
By the same token, anything that might be important musically, I would be more than happy to see that they went to the Smithsonian Institute.
